_note: v6.4: v6.3 (v10.3 + ConvNeXt-Base independent CNN) with the CNN member replaced by aniq_independent_convnext_base_336_1split (336 px, separate crop/disease epochs, one validation split). Single change from v6.3. Weight and gamma chosen on the same validation split; v10.3's validation scores are copied from v6.3 (same split), and the CNN's come from its saved split-1 predictions (val_logp_split1.npz).
title: convnext336_ensemble

ensemble._note: Weight on the first member (v10.3) from 0 to 1 in steps of 0.1; w = 1 is v10.3 alone, w = 0 ConvNeXt-Base alone.

validation._note: Same split procedure, seed and settings as v5. gamma is in log-probability units here (both members are on the log-prob scale), so the grid is 0-15 in steps of 0.1; v5's 0.0725 cosine corresponds to 7.25.
